title: Settings
description: Settings of the authentik agent. Unset values use their defaults.

debug.description: Log at trace instead of info level. Default: false.

ssh_fallback_agent.description:
Optional fallback/passthrough SSH agent used for hosts not managed by authentik
(e.g. github.com, gitlab.com). When unset, nothing is forwarded.

allowed_exchange_audiences.description: Audiences (client IDs) tokens may be exchanged for. Default: any audience.

remember.description: How long answers to authorization prompts are remembered for the same caller.

allow_delete.description: Whether profiles can be deleted. Default: true.

allow_plaintext_tokens.description:
Whether tokens may be stored in plain text in the config file when no keyring is
available. Default: true.

allowed_urls.description: authentik URLs profiles may be set up for. Default: any URL.

require_dpop.description:
Only allow profiles whose tokens are bound to a key on this device (DPoP). Needs a
provider that supports key binding. Default: false.

allow.description: Seconds an allowed request isn't prompted for again.

deny.description: Seconds a denied request is denied again without prompting.

authorize.description: Generic approvals for a service the caller names. Default: 7200s allowed, 300s denied.

current_token.description: Handing out the session token. Default: 300s allowed, 900s denied.

ssh_login.description: Logging in to an SSH host. Default: 1800s allowed, 300s denied.

token_exchange.description: Exchanging a token for another application. Default: 1800s allowed, 1s denied.

whoami.description: Reading account info. Default: 0s allowed, 0s denied.

extra_passthrough_hosts.description:
Extra hosts that should always be routed to the fallback agent,
bypassing authentik entirely, given as `known_hosts`-format lines
(e.g. the output of `ssh-keyscan your-host.example.com`).

socket_path.description:
Path to the fallback SSH agent socket (e.g. the system's original
`SSH_AUTH_SOCK`, or a hardware-key agent) used for hosts not managed
by authentik.

agent_tunnel.description:
Answer authentik agent tunnel requests from forwarded SSH agents, which lets remote
hosts call this agent (authorization prompts still apply). Default: true.

builtin_passthrough_hosts.description: Send github.com and gitlab.com straight to the fallback agent. Default: true.

enabled.description: Serve the SSH agent. Takes effect after a restart. Default: true.

error_reporting.description: Send errors and performance traces to authentik's Sentry. Default: true.

update_check.description: Check for new releases. Default: true.
